name: Tuck
conversations: Wanna race? First one to the plaza wins. Winner gets to blow on the chimes.
...Nobody ever wins that one. They don't ring.
I climbed nearly to the far cliff once. There's a big tangly thing on top, all white and twisty.
Mum says don't go near it. I wasn't scared. Much.
Captain Brisk says the wind's just sulking. Can wind sulk?
If it can, I bet it's 'cause nobody said sorry.
When I grow up I'm going to be a wind-maker. I'll make it in a big jar and let it out on special days.
